hooks.logic:
Count up "turnInCurrState".
If not (call game:AbilityMgr.getInstance) → exists-registered-interrupt-ability and the enemy can act and the enemy is ready to act, then
  Let ability be the id of the move labelled list on the enemy.
  Let list2 be [].
  If the count "turnInCurrState" is less than 2, then set list2 to ability.
  Let ability2 be a weighted random move of the enemy other than list2.
  If ability contains ability2, then choose state 21 next.
  Otherwise, if ability2 is the id of the move labelled "needles_10000" on the enemy, then the enemy uses ability2 with options {maxDamageThresholdType: game:Conf.DAMAGE_THRESHOLD_TYPE.PRIMARY}.
  Otherwise, the enemy uses ability2.

If condition flag "receive_damage" is up this frame, then set the register's 'isReceivedDamageWhenDance' to true.
If not (call game:AbilityMgr.getInstance) → exists-registered-interrupt-ability and the enemy can act, then

  Otherwise
    If the enemy is ready to act, then the enemy uses the built-in move DO_NOTHING.
    Stop.
